default.question: What is included in Bluelink LITE?
default.answer: Bluelink LITE includes Connected Routing, EV Route Planner, vehicle system updates, and basic app connectivity. It's free for 10 years on all new vehicles.

default.question: Can I upgrade my Bluelink package?
default.answer: Yes, you can easily upgrade your Bluelink package through the Bluelink Store or your Hyundai dealer at any time.

default.question: Do I need to install any additional hardware?
default.answer: No additional hardware is required. All Bluelink services work through your vehicle's existing connectivity features.

default.question: What happens after my free trial period ends?
default.answer: After your free trial period, you can choose to continue with a monthly or annual subscription, or downgrade to a different package.
